It appears that the presence of .webm is treated as .webm extension, regardless of its location. This will cause some websites, containing .webm in their paths, to be treated as embedded videos. The effective .webm extension should be detected within the basename of it's path, i.e. the name after the last '/' char.

Original bug report without [PREVIEW LinPg] format.

  • real .webm http://video.webmfiles.org/big-buck-bunny_trailer.webm
